questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Five identities have seven placements. All base26RP/rank9/class17/V,S,F/range120ft. Absolute Gate casts in10MINUTES; the other four use an Action. Gate has Conjuration,Transmutation and Universal placements but actual Cleric access is Universal and Druid/Mage/Wizard access Conjuration.
options: Keep actual access and resolve each placement explicitly.
A source-faithful alternate reconciliation with each change labelled NEW.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: No fourth Gate identity or new Transmutation access grant. Absolute Gate has no Druid grant; Fortress has no Cleric grant. Preserve real acquisition,automatic features,components,pricing/strain,concentration/counter sequence and source-specific interruptions.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original planar accounts,mortal maps,saved website and current spell-local planeKeys have distinct authority.
options: Use actual established plane/site identities and explicit generated spell-space identities.
Another bounded operational representation that preserves all source distinctions.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not identify Fire with Bastion,Shadowfell with Veiled Expanse,an exile cell with an afterlife,or website radii with distances. Original manuscripts plus later owner corrections govern; unknown native origins remain unknown. A generated fortress can have a real spell-space identity without redefining the cosmological map.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Conjuration opens a portal to ANY PLANE OR LOCATION; Transmutation/Universal say ANOTHER PLANE. CoreInstantaneous does not specify how long passage remains possible.
options: One common broad portal procedure preserving the broader printed destination clause across legitimate routes.
Source-route-specific destination modes with all three placements explicitly reconciled.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Decide same-plane versus other-plane access without silently deleting any plane or location. Choose duration/concentration/opening and closing as NEW; do not copy a one-minute or one-transit cap merely because a lower spell uses it. No creature-calling,true-name summons or command power is printed.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No known-place qualifier is printed,unlike Absolute Gate;120ft can govern local opening rather than remote destination distance.
options: An exact destination-designation contract with stated allowed knowledge/reference methods.
A wider explicit destination selector preserving the any-location promise and hidden-information boundary.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Settle known versus unknown but unambiguously designated places as a real source choice. Do not silently import Absolute Gate knowledge wording or allow vague requests to become free remote scouting. An unavailable authored destination is a named dependency,not a fictional plane or automatic nearest convenient substitute.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Portal topology,size,orientation,one-way/bidirectional behavior and travel classification are unspecified.
options: Precisely placed fixed linked apertures with explicit crossing and classification.
Another complete portal topology preserving actual useful passage.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select dimensions/poses,local placement LoE,remote arrival metadata and physical-gateway versus teleport transaction as NEW. Applied Faction Portal is one-way teleport while Alignment Portal is bidirectional nonteleport planar travel; neither is universal. Apply No Escape,Verdict Absolute,Reign of Ashes and Dimensional Anchor only to the chosen actual predicates.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Real creatures,cargo,mounts,carried passengers and forced movement can intersect an aperture.
options: Atomic whole-transit groups using actual body fit,custody and movement.
A separately defined partial-crossing model with complete safe lifecycle semantics.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve actual anatomy,squeezing,height,load/weight,support and all transported bodies. Decide movement cost,forced crossing and unattended-object permission without silently inheriting low-rank payload caps. No bisected creature,duplicate inventory,free action,unearned force or after-failure remote tactical relocation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Opening a portal does not explicitly settle sight,sound,spell lines,projectiles,fluids or pressure exchange.
options: Specify each channel independently with actual geometry and source rules.
A deliberately opaque transport-only aperture with its new restrictions explicit.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the channels as consequential NEW scope. A visual opening alone does not automatically grant cross-plane targeting/casting origin; conversely do not silently discard ordinary passage benefits. If mass/environment can cross,state support,flow,conservation and feedback limits rather than importing infinite-pressure or free-resource behavior.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core explicitly requires10MINUTE casting,while the catalog leaves activation unspecified.
options: Preserve a real600second casting process with exact commitment,maintenance and interruption checkpoints.
Another explicit long-cast procedure that still requires the full printed10minutes.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not turn it into an Action,free downtime skip or generic Ready payload. State RP/components and concentration/counter/strain timing using actual existing long-activity rules,authoring only missing parts. Ritual Casting or Ritual Mastery is not automatically applicable from a long casting time; no Ritual tag is printed here.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: PERMANENT PORTAL versus CoreUNTIL DISPELLED.
options: An indefinite ongoing magical gate ending only through explicitly defined removal/closure.
An enduring created connection with exact dispelling semantics.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve permanence without a hidden daily renewal,minute cap or caster-alive requirement. Decide whether voluntary closure pauses/reopens or terminates;dispelling must have a real meaning under the Core source. No blanket immunity to dispel follows from the title Absolute.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: ANY KNOWN PLANE OR PLACE is explicit,but knowledge and exact site coordinates are not defined.
options: Exact known location through stated reliable reference methods and actual existing site data.
A deliberately broader known-plane selector with explicit destination choice rules.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Knowing a plane name and knowing a usable arrival site are distinct. Decide how much acquaintance,description or map suffices and how remote formation checks work. Preserve useful same-plane and cross-plane reach; no arbitrary distance ceiling,no invented universal corresponding coordinates,and no paid failure that reveals protected destination details.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanent infrastructure has no printed per-caster count,credential,transfer or retargeting policy.
options: Stable individually owned gate records with explicit controls and any deliberately selected limits.
A named replacement or shared-network model justified as NEW.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not silently impose one active gate,grant unlimited retargeting,or equate creator with traveler permission. Decide who can use/close/reopen/remove it,what persists after death/absence,and how credentials are actually checked. Creating a gate grants no destination property rights or faction access.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Destination support,occupancy,wards and moving or destroyed sites can change after formation.
options: Revalidate each actual transit against fixed endpoints and current blockers.
Another explicit anchored endpoint lifecycle.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Separate formation from transit: accepted Dimensional Anchor blocks qualifying transport transactions,not automatically inert portal formation. Decide moving vessels,site demolition,blocked exits,mid-crossing closure and local suppression. Failed legal commitments retain actual costs/history; no split group,clock refresh or automatic return after gate loss.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A PORTAL AUTOMATICALLY BANISHES SPECIFIC CREATURE TYPES; no type list or number of selected types is printed.
options: Choose explicit existing creature-type predicates fixed at creation.
Another complete source-defined selection contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define number of selected categories as NEW. Actual Elemental,outsider,extraplanar,summoned,native-plane and faction predicates are different. Do not invent species taxonomy,derive type from appearance or reduce the promise to one named creature. Qualifying allies/caster require explicit treatment; no enemy-only clause is printed.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Automatic portal operation has no printed save,entry event,recurrence cadence or range around its opening.
options: Automatic banishment on a precisely defined genuine crossing/exposure event.
Another exact automatic trigger preserving the portal and selected-type benefit.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve touch,crossing,formation overlap,forced entry,already-inside bodies and type changes. Do not import Banishment CHA save silently or turn automatic into a chance gate. Define repeated eligible events and same-event arbitration; immunity/suppression is not an excuse to multiply attempts or create a hidden type readout.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Neither the banishment destination nor the gate/exile duration,concentration or return is specified; CoreInstantaneous.
options: Explicitly extend accepted temporary cell/return interfaces with a new gate and per-target lifetime.
Send to a real source-qualified destination under a separately complete banishment/return contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose as NEW,not by the word banishment alone. Do not infer home/native plane,soul removal,permanent death or despawning. Define whether multiple targets share space or have separate cells,what closes when the gate ends,and how escape,real agency and clocks behave.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Automatic removal may conflict with existing source-character/target/encounter hard-denial protection and single attached Banishment policy.
options: Apply the exact guard with a source-specific ownership/admission model and explicit cross-family composition.
A narrowly selected exception justified by the printed automatic clause.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not quietly waive or generalize the guard. Decide voluntary admission,independent existing exiles,simultaneous gates and same/different creators. A failed establishment cannot spend an unestablished exile claim; no soft fallback is invented. Existing ordinary Banishment primary slots are not automatically a global resource.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Body,cargo and terminal placement remain real while a gate can admit many subjects over time.
options: Exact per-body/cargo records and finite terminal settlement with explicitly adopted cell extensions.
Another complete custody/return model preserving every extant identity.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve carried creatures,swallowed bodies,tethers,summon expiry,death,reversion and loose objects. Banishment terminal blocker exceptions apply here only after an express extension,not automatically. A failed return fit cannot erase cargo,restore dead bodies,freeze life clocks or silently keep a supposedly ended space forever.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: AREA IMMUNE TO EFFECTS FROM ONE SPECIFIC PLANE; no origin predicate is given.
options: Define effect-origin provenance at its actual creation and continuation checkpoints.
A different precise operational meaning of from a plane.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Distinguish current caster position,original cast plane,native creature origin,last travel plane,created-from metadata,carried artifacts and descendant effects. Applied Planar Protection governs incoming creatures using arrival provenance; it does not decide this broader effect-immunity predicate. No theme,damage type or deity name supplies origin.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Range120ft/Instantaneous with no area dimensions,lifetime or concentration.
options: A specified fixed ward volume and exact ongoing lifetime.
Another source-faithful area geometry and duration model.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose radius/shape,boundary intersection,center LoE,placement and concentration as NEW. Do not use another spell15ft/20ft radius by default. Define affected creatures,objects and environmental regions,including preexisting occupants and entering/leaving bodies. Immunity must be a useful actual area benefit.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: EFFECTS is broader than attacks or harmful spells; IMMUNE is stronger than a numerical resistance.
options: Explicitly enumerate covered magical,physical,informational and environmental effects using actual source provenance.
A chosen narrower interpretation with the source departure recorded.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve the broad promise and specific-plane restriction. Decide damage,conditions,control,buffs,healing,sensing,summons,transport and ongoing fields independently; do not silently make it damage-only,enemy-only or general immunity to all planes. Creature exclusion or physical wall behavior is not automatically an effect-immunity benefit.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A remote source may persist locally,be copied,reflected,transferred or generate later pulses after its owner travels.
options: Stable provenance on actual parents/descendants with explicit new-root rules.
A live provenance re-evaluation model with complete event ordering.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Separate causal origin from present location and source owner. Resolve boundary entry,already established conditions,source suppression and independently lawful new local casts. No laundering a prohibited effect by transferring it through a local proxy or retroactive reversal of completed damage/learned information unless the chosen source expressly requires it.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The ward itself can be affected by suppression,dispel and other planar/antimagic defenses.
options: Apply exact named removal/suppression rules and any necessary bounded self-consistency exception.
A different explicitly scoped ward lifecycle.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve a sanctuary choosing its own formation plane,overlapping sanctuaries,different caster sources and same-time arrivals. No unconditional self-immunity or invulnerability follows from immune area wording. Null retains actual root/target semantics; school wards and terminal returns require their exact predicates.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: PERMANENT EXTRADIMENSIONAL STRONGHOLD,CoreAction120ft/UntilDispelled; no dimensions,layout or building statistics.
options: Create a useful finite fortified space with expressly authored geometry,structures and environmental properties.
Another concrete stronghold profile preserving the full printed benefit.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not reduce a stronghold to a bare tiny room or cosmetic doorway. Choose usable area,rooms,defenses,doors,structure damage/support and navigation as NEW. Do not import a foreign-game mansion/demiplane profile or invent a named cosmic dominion; pending Demiplane and Creation are comparisons only.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanent versusUntilDispelled requires distinct space,structure and entrance lifecycles.
options: Indefinite magical stronghold whose real dispelling contract explicitly settles interior and contents.
Enduring created structure with a separately dispellable access/effect layer.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the actual conflict resolution before writing examples. No unprinted rest renewal,1minute expiration or automatic creator-death cleanup. Specify concentration,individual-cast identity,repeat creation and any new capacity/count limit without silently treating all casts as the same reusable pocket.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: How inhabitants enter,reenter,exit or become trapped is not specified.
options: Stable known access point(s) with exact ownership,permission and transit rules.
Another complete persistent access/return model.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define origin120ftplacement,entry aperture,interior coordinates,knowledge of the created site and lawful independent gate access. State who can operate entrances after creator absence/death,what closing a door does,and whether access can be moved. Actual entrance closures need not destroy an otherwise permanent fortress; any fallback exit is explicit NEW authorship.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A stronghold can hold actual cargo,companions,workshops,farms and research resources.
options: Real persistent space and inventory with exact supplied amenities and native work/resource rules.
Another complete materiality model preserving the usable stronghold.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: State what is actually created versus moved in,structural material export/harvesting,food/air/water/light,tools and manufacturing inputs. No automatic loot,free reagents,unearned worker actions or duplicated contents. Equally,do not forbid legitimate player-built work simply to avoid complexity; actual crafting,companion jobs,rest and custody follow their real prerequisites.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Dispel,suppression,structural destruction or ending can occur with bodies/corpses and loose property inside.
options: A complete finite evacuation/placement contract with exact terminal exceptions selected.
A persistent inaccessible-space model with explicitly lawful recovery and real continuing clocks.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the full physical outcome; do not silently copy Banishment terminal rules without extension. Include anchors,moving old entrances,blocked origins,multiple bodies,mandatory reversion,expired summons and actual object IDs. No deletion,bisection,resource reset or resurrection by save/load; an unresolved fit must retain real identity and an explicit operational state.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Extradimensional shelter is not explicitly safe from all enemies,pauses or campaign consequences.
options: Actual environment,access security and 1:1 clocks unless a separately accepted exception applies.
A deliberately selected spell-local environmental/time exception with every outside clock stated.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve useful fortification while applying real rest requirements,work intervals,Opening/Horn,Hunt,conditions and concentration. No default time dilation,infinite rests,automatic Extraction,tax/claim erasure or guaranteed divine refuge. Any interaction with existing campaign route or floor restrictions must use actual source authority,not an invented ban on planar travel.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Several real portals,wards,exiles and created spaces can compose or end at the same timestamp.
options: Deterministic source/application/event identities with atomic transport and exact parent cleanup.
Another complete composition policy with equivalent custody and chronology.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve causal order,real movement spent,prospective arrival provenance and original deadlines. Specify crossing loops,simultaneous endpoints and nested generated spaces without inventing free infinite Actions or deleting a world. Do not expose hidden destination,type or ward facts through preflight diagnostics,record counts or arbitrary refunds.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: These procedures must support exploration,tactical combat and persistent companion/resource management.
options: Full operational procedures,source-qualified positive encounters and persistent state contracts.
Another equally complete authored review package.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Return all30 decisions,allseven native placements,two full useful encounters per identity and independent edge branches with actual casts,actors,geometry,costs,clocks and final state. Do not replace positive behavior with refusal guards. Keep genuine missing content narrowly explicit; preserve originals and distinguish source/semantic/runtime/human/balance/canon/release. Owner implementation reservation remains.

addenda.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted Transport6 deliberately distinguishes teleport transactions, nonteleport planar passage and terminal settlement; persistent new infrastructure does not inherit every lower spell restriction or fallback.
addenda.request: Use exact applied Transport6 procedures and all current relevant scoped actors/sources. Select this family actual transport predicate and expressly adopted terminal exceptions. Demonstrate successful whole-body/cargo crossings and later nonempty closure with moving/blocked endpoints, dead bodies, mandatory reversion and expired companions. Preserve each generated space distinct identity, all actual clocks and real inventory; never convert a failed fit into deletion, resurrection, free relocation or unbounded refresh.

addenda.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanent useful infrastructure, chosen-plane effect immunity and exact ownership/custody cannot be reduced to generic temporary zones. Copy/reflection/transfer and local source travel may change location without changing causal provenance.
addenda.request: Author full useful permanent gate/fortress geometry, access rights, created materials, legitimate work/rest and exact dispel outcomes without granting free inputs or inventing count caps. For Sanctuary define origin for actual magical,physical,informational,beneficial and ongoing effects and self-plane selection. If Magic7 is accepted bind its real transfer/reflection rules; otherwise record the exact joint dependency and retain real positive cases rather than substituting broad unsupported refusals.

requiredCases.requiredEvidence: Actual legal Conjuration and Universal routes with explicit placement reconciliation, useful same-plane/cross-plane travel, fixed apertures and exact full-body movement/cargo accounting.
Real changing endpoint occupancy, forced/carried/mounted entry, selected environmental and targeting channels, suppression or mid-crossing closure with exact scoped blockers.
Real600second paid formation using native components and interruptions, known site and indefinite later reuse after creator absence, complete stable permission and endpoint records.
Nonempty later crossings including moving/blocked destination, actual suppression/dispel and chosen closure versus destruction with preserved bodies/property and no new renewal requirement.
Actual multiple creature types including matching ally/enemy and nonmatching control, genuine automatic trigger and positive exile under selected source guard/ownership model.
Multiple independently timed occupants/cargo, escaped or dead body/expired summon, occupied return and closing gate with full expressly adopted terminal settlement.
Useful actual ward volume and selected-plane provenance showing harmful and beneficial effect immunity, different-plane controls, ongoing sources and boundary crossing.
Actual source travel/copy/transfer/later pulses, self-plane and overlapping ward selection, exact dispel/suppression without origin laundering or retroactive reversal of spent outcomes.
Concrete permanent fortified navigable space and access, real loaded cargo/companions, source-qualified productive work/rest and creator absence without fabricated inputs or time dilation.
Actual occupied closure/dispel/suppression/structural destruction with all bodies/corpses/loose objects, nested space and blocked origin settlement preserving identity and real continuing clocks.

futureObligations.requirements: Actual legal class17+ access,correct school,cost,components,automatic feature/strain history and counter timing. Include full600second Absolute Gate process and interruptions; generic Ready cannot prepare that long cast.

Useful same-plane and cross-plane destinations under the selected placement reconciliation; exact apertures,orientations,all body fits,movement,custody and final arrival records. Demonstrate actual successful travel rather than only blocked-destination checks.

Completed10minute formation,known actual destination,permanent later reuse,creator absence/death and explicit access controls. Trace real dispel/suppression,blocked exit and stable inventories without hidden duration renewal.

Multiple actual creature types,qualifying ally/enemy,nonmatching control and real automatic trigger. Show actual positive removal,selected hard-denial treatment,real custody,independent escape and full return with an occupied/blocked origin.

A real chosen-plane-origin effect and different-plane control,inside/outside boundary bodies and preexisting ongoing effects. Trace selected origin across source travel,copy/transfer/pulse,beneficial as well as harmful components and exact protection/suppression order.

A useful actual stronghold profile with navigable rooms/doors,entry/reentry,real carried property,companions and productive work/rest inputs. Show persistence across modes and creator absence,then full nonempty dispel/closure disposition without erased or duplicated state.

Exact accepted Anchor,Planar Protection,Planar Barrier and Paladin No Escape/Verdict/Reign predicates. Compare formation versus crossing,voluntary versus forced,mount/passenger and prospective-arrival metadata. No imaginary transit-path test between unrelated endpoints.
Real deadlines,Opening/Horn,Hunt,death/summon/condition clocks and actual rest/work duration. Extra turns,mode changes,portal suppression and save/load supply no reset or unstated time dilation.

Simultaneous crossing/closure,overlapping sources,nested generated spaces,mandatory reversion,loose items and blocked terminal placement. Every body/item retains identity/provenance and exact current state; authored cases are not engine execution or cosmology approval.
